{{Top|leg}}
A '''codicil partner''' was a non-[[Primary partner|primary spouse]] of a [[Muun/Legends|Muun]]. [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] was the child of [[Caar Damask|his father's]] codicil partner. Even so, [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] society allowed for offspring of codicils to eventually inherit their fathers' entire wealth, as happened with Damask, the Muun who would eventually become [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Plagueis.<ref name="Darth Plagueis novel">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>
